description.zh_CN: 通过 Komari Agent 在各节点运行 IPQuality 脚本，收集 IP 类型、风险评分、风险因子、黑名单与邮局端口结果，并以快照接口提供给主题和页面。
description.en: Runs the IPQuality script on each node through the Komari agent and serves IP type, risk scores, risk factors, blacklist and mail-port results as a snapshot API for themes and pages.
